description: 观临已实现直连链接导入视频，可看单集动画片和剧，电影我还没测试所以还不知道。内里可让char主动发消息，用手机自带的自动旋转功能可实现横屏，横屏下char的消息将以弹幕的方式呈现。但是由于技术原因和糯叽的硬性限制，那个本地导入视频不可超过8M，并且要点左上角的返回退出软件才会出现导入视频的弹窗所以我建议大家还是用直连链接。

<div class="app-shell">

    <!-- ===== 顶部栏 ===== -->
    <div class="topbar">

        <button class="icon-btn" onclick="openSettings()">•••</button>

    <!-- ===== 主内容 ===== -->
    <div class="main-content">

        <!-- 首页 -->
        <div class="page active" id="homePage">
            <div class="home-header">
                <div class="main-title">为了没有眼泪的明天</div>

            <div class="compose-entry" onclick="openCompose()">

                <div id="folderList"></div>
                <div class="footer-add" onclick="createFolder()">
                    <span class="plus">+</span> 新建文件夹

            </div>

        <!-- 写信页 -->
        <div class="page" id="composePage">
            <div class="compose-input-area">
                <textarea id="questionInput" placeholder="你想问什么？"></textarea>

            <div class="time-selector">
                <button class="seg active" data-value="now" onclick="selectTime('now', this)">现在</button>
                <button class="seg" data-value="past" onclick="selectTime('past', this)">过去</button>
                <button class="seg" data-value="future" onclick="selectTime('future', this)">未来</button>

            <button class="bottom-btn" onclick="openCharSheet()">📎</button>
            <div class="divider"></div>

    <!-- ===== Toast ===== -->

            <div class="confirm-msg" id="confirmMsg">删除后无法恢复。</div>
            <div class="confirm-actions">

                <button class="btn btn-danger" id="confirmOkBtn">删除</button>

    </div>

    <!-- ===== 自定义输入弹窗（新建文件夹用） ===== -->

            <div class="input-actions">

<script>
    // ============================================================
    //  顶栏返回键处理：首页→退出，其他页→返回上一级
    // ============================================================
    function handleBack() {
        const activePage = document.querySelector('.page.active');
        if (!activePage) return;
        const pageId = activePage.id;
        if (pageId === 'homePage') {
            closeApp();
        } else {
            goBack();
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  关闭 App（返回主屏幕）
    // ============================================================
    function closeApp() {
        if (typeof Nuojiji !== 'undefined' && Nuojiji.close) {
            Nuojiji.close();
        } else {
            window.close();
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  数据
    // ============================================================
    const STORAGE_KEY = 'timecapsule_v13';

    const DEFAULT_FOLDERS = [
        { id: '__now', name: '寄往现在', system: true },
        { id: '__past', name: '寄往过去', system: true },
        { id: '__future', name: '寄往未来', system: true },
    ];

    let appData = { folders: [], letters: [] };
    let currentFolder = '__now';
    let currentChar = null;
    let currentTime = 'now';
    let characters = [];
    let selectedLang = 'zh';
    let pageStack = ['home'];

    // 版本管理
    let versions = [];
    let currentVersionIndex = -1;
    let currentQuestion = '';
    let currentCharId = null;

    let currentDetailLetterId = null;
    let detailTranslatedText = null;

    // ============================================================
    //  确认弹窗
    // ============================================================
    let _confirmResolve = null;

    function showConfirm(options) {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            _confirmResolve = resolve;
            document.getElementById('confirmIcon').textContent = options.icon || '🗑️';
            document.getElementById('confirmTitle').textContent = options.title || '确认删除';
            document.getElementById('confirmMsg').textContent = options.message || '删除后无法恢复。';
            document.getElementById('confirmOkBtn').textContent = options.okText || '删除';
            document.getElementById('confirmCancelBtn').textContent = options.cancelText || '取消';
            document.getElementById('confirmOverlay').classList.add('show');
        });
    }

    function closeConfirm(result) {
        document.getElementById('confirmOverlay').classList.remove('show');
        if (_confirmResolve) {
            const done = _confirmResolve;
            _confirmResolve = null;
            done(!!result);
        }
    }

    document.getElementById('confirmCancelBtn').addEventListener('click', () => closeConfirm(false));
    document.getElementById('confirmOkBtn').addEventListener('click', () => closeConfirm(true));
    document.getElementById('confirmOverlay').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeConfirm(false);
    });

    // ============================================================
    //  自定义输入弹窗（新建文件夹）
    // ============================================================
    let _inputResolve = null;

    function showInput(title, placeholder) {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            _inputResolve = resolve;
            document.getElementById('inputOverlay').classList.add('show');
            document.getElementById('folderNameInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('folderNameInput').placeholder = placeholder || '输入名称';
            document.getElementById('folderNameInput').focus();
            document.getElementById('folderNameInput').onkeydown = function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') confirmFolder();
            };
        });
    }

    function closeInput() {
        document.getElementById('inputOverlay').classList.remove('show');
        if (_inputResolve) {
            const done = _inputResolve;
            _inputResolve = null;
            done(null);
        }
    }

    function confirmFolder() {
        const name = document.getElementById('folderNameInput').value.trim();
        if (_inputResolve) {
            const done = _inputResolve;
            _inputResolve = null;
            document.getElementById('inputOverlay').classList.remove('show');
            done(name || null);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Toast
    // ============================================================
    function showToast(text) {
        const el = document.getElementById('toast');
        el.textContent = text;
        el.classList.add('show');
        clearTimeout(el._timer);
        el._timer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 2500);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  数据持久化
    // ============================================================
    function loadData() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
            if (raw) {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
                appData.folders = parsed.folders || [];
                appData.letters = parsed.letters || [];
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function saveData() {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                folders: appData.folders,
                letters: appData.letters,
            }));
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function loadSettings() {
        try {
            const lang = localStorage.getItem('timecapsule_lang_v13');
            if (lang) {
                selectedLang = lang;
                updateLangChecks();
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function saveSettings(lang) {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('timecapsule_lang_v13', lang);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  角色
    // ============================================================
    async function loadCharacters() {
        try {
            const list = await nuo.roster.list();
            if (list && list.length) {
                characters = list;
                if (!currentChar && characters.length > 0) {
                    currentChar = characters[0];
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('读取角色失败');
        }
    }

    function getCharName(id) {
        const found = characters.find(c => c.id === id);
        return found ? found.name : '未知角色';
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  页面切换
    // ============================================================
    function showPage(pageId) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById(pageId).classList.add('active');

        const wrapper = document.getElementById('bottomWrapper');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
        if (pageId === 'composePage') {
            wrapper.classList.add('show');
            sendBtn.classList.add('show');
        } else {
            wrapper.classList.remove('show');
            sendBtn.classList.remove('show');
        }
    }

    function goBack() {
        if (pageStack.length <= 1) return;
        pageStack.pop();
        const prev = pageStack[pageStack.length - 1];
        if (prev === 'home') {
            showPage('homePage');
            renderFolderList();
        } else if (prev === 'letters') {
            showPage('lettersPage');
            renderLetters();
        }
    }

    function pushPage(pageId) {
        pageStack.push(pageId);
        showPage(pageId);
    }

    function openCompose() {
        pushPage('composePage');
        versions = [];
        currentVersionIndex = -1;
        document.getElementById('answerSection').classList.remove('show');
        document.getElementById('versionBar').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('translateBtn').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('questionInput').value = '';
    }

    function openFolderView(id) {
        currentFolder = id;
        pushPage('lettersPage');
        renderLetters();
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  文件夹
    // ============================================================
    function getAllFolders() {
        return [...DEFAULT_FOLDERS, ...appData.folders];
    }

    function getFolderName(id) {
        const found = getAllFolders().find(f => f.id === id);
        return found ? found.name : '未知';
    }

    function renderFolderList() {
        const container = document.getElementById('folderList');
        const folders = getAllFolders();
        container.innerHTML = folders.map(f => {
            const count = appData.letters.filter(l => l.folderId === f.id).length;
            const isSystem = DEFAULT_FOLDERS.some(df => df.id === f.id);
            return `<div class="folder-item" onclick="openFolderView('${f.id}')">
                <span class="folder-name ${isSystem ? 'system' : ''}">${f.name}</span>
                <span class="folder-count">${count}</span>
            </div>`;
        }).join('');
    }

    async function createFolder() {
        const name = await showInput('新建文件夹', '输入文件夹名称');
        if (!name) return;
        const id = 'custom_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
        appData.folders.push({ id, name: name.trim() });
        saveData();
        renderFolderList();
        updateComposeFolderSelect();
        showToast('已创建文件夹');
    }

    // 长按删除自定义文件夹
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
        const item = e.target.closest('.folder-item');
        if (!item) return;
        const onclick = item.getAttribute('onclick');
        if (!onclick) return;
        const match = onclick.match(/openFolderView\('([^']+)'\)/);
        if (!match) return;
        const id = match[1];
        const isSystem = DEFAULT_FOLDERS.some(f => f.id === id);
        if (isSystem) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        showConfirm({
            icon: '📂',
            title: '删除文件夹',
            message: '确定删除文件夹「' + getFolderName(id) + '」及其所有信件吗？',
            okText: '确认删除',
            cancelText: '取消'
        }).then((ok) => {
            if (!ok) return;
            appData.folders = appData.folders.filter(f => f.id !== id);
            appData.letters = appData.letters.filter(l => l.folderId !== id);
            saveData();
            if (currentFolder === id) {
                currentFolder = '__now';
                if (document.getElementById('lettersPage').classList.contains('active')) {
                    goBack();
                }
            }
            renderFolderList();
            updateComposeFolderSelect();
            if (document.getElementById('lettersPage').classList.contains('active')) {
                renderLetters();
            }
            showToast('已删除文件夹');
        });
    });

    // ============================================================
    //  时间选择
    // ============================================================
    function selectTime(val, el) {
        currentTime = val;
        document.querySelectorAll('.time-selector .seg').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
        if (el) el.classList.add('active');

        const yearWrap = document.getElementById('yearWrap');
        const yearHint = document.getElementById('yearHint');
        if (val === 'now') {
            yearWrap.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
            yearWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
            yearHint.textContent = val === 'past' ? '年前' : '年后';
        }
    }

    function selectTimeFromSheet(val) {
        closeSheets();
        const segs = document.querySelectorAll('.time-selector .seg');
        let target = null;
        segs.forEach(s => {
            if (s.dataset.value === val) target = s;
        });
        if (target) selectTime(val, target);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Sheet 弹窗
    // ============================================================
    function openSheets(sheetId) {
        document.getElementById('sheetOverlay').classList.add('show');
        document.getElementById(sheetId).classList.add('show');
    }

    function closeSheets() {
        document.getElementById('sheetOverlay').classList.remove('show');
        document.querySelectorAll('.sheet:not(#detailSheet)').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('show'));
    }

    function openCharSheet() {
        const container = document.getElementById('charSheetList');
        if (characters.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = '<div class="sheet-item" style="color:#636366;">暂无角色，先去创建吧</div>';
        } else {
            container.innerHTML = characters.map(c => `
                <div class="sheet-item" onclick="selectCharFromSheet('${c.id}')">
                    ${c.name || '未命名'}
                    ${currentChar && currentChar.id === c.id ? '<span class="check">✓</span>' : ''}
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
        openSheets('charSheet');
    }

    function selectCharFromSheet(id) {
        currentChar = characters.find(c => c.id === id);
        closeSheets();
    }

    function renderFolderSheet() {
        const container = document.getElementById('folderSheetList');
        const folders = getAllFolders();
        container.innerHTML = folders.map(f => `
            <div class="sheet-item" onclick="selectFolderFromSheet('${f.id}')">
                ${f.name}
                ${currentFolder === f.id ? '<span class="check">✓</span>' : ''}
            </div>
        `).join('');
    }

    function openFolderSheet() {
        renderFolderSheet();
        openSheets('folderSheet');
    }

    function selectFolderFromSheet(id) {
        currentFolder = id;
        closeSheets();
    }

    function openTimeSheet() {
        openSheets('timeSheet');
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  设置（语言）
    // ============================================================
    function updateLangChecks() {
        const langs = ['zh', 'en', 'ja', 'ko', 'fr', 'es'];
        langs.forEach(l => {
            const el = document.getElementById('langCheck_' + l);
            if (el) el.textContent = l === selectedLang ? '✓' : '';
        });
    }

    function openSettings() {
        updateLangChecks();
        document.getElementById('settingsSheet').classList.add('show');
        document.getElementById('sheetOverlay').classList.add('show');
    }

    function closeSettings() {
        document.getElementById('settingsSheet').classList.remove('show');
        document.getElementById('sheetOverlay').classList.remove('show');
    }

    function setLanguage(lang) {
        selectedLang = lang;
        saveSettings(lang);
        updateLangChecks();
        showToast('语言已切换');
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  写信
    // ============================================================
    async function sendLetter() {
        const question = document.getElementById('questionInput').value.trim();
        if (!currentChar) { showToast('请选择寄给谁'); return; }
        if (!question) { showToast('请写下你的问题'); return; }

        currentQuestion = question;
        currentCharId = currentChar.id;

        versions = [];
        currentVersionIndex = -1;

        await generateAnswer();
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  生成回答（核心）
    // ============================================================
    async function generateAnswer() {
        const question = currentQuestion;
        const charId = currentCharId;
        const charName = getCharName(charId);
        if (!question || !charId) return;

        const yearOffset = parseInt(document.getElementById('yearOffset').value) || 5;

        let timeDesc = '现在';
        if (currentTime === 'past') timeDesc = `${yearOffset}年前`;
        else if (currentTime === 'future') timeDesc = `${yearOffset}年后`;

        const timePrompt = currentTime === 'now'
            ? '以你现在的身份回答。'
            : currentTime === 'past'
            ? `以${yearOffset}年前的你的身份回答。`
            : `以${yearOffset}年后的你的身份回答。`;

        const langMap = {
            'zh': '中文',
            'en': 'English',
            'ja': '日本語',
            'ko': '한국어',
            'fr': 'Français',
            'es': 'Español'
        };
        const langName = langMap[selectedLang] || '中文';

        const systemPrompt = `你是${charName}。请以第一人称写一段话，回答以下问题。

要求：
- 100-500字
- 纯文字，不要任何描写（不要写动作、神态、环境）
- 不要称呼、不要落款、不要书信格式
- 就像在认真回答一个问题，自然、真挚
- 用${langName}写

时间背景：${timeDesc}`;

        const btn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '⋯';

        try {
            const messages = [
                { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
                { role: 'user', content: question }
            ];

            const result = await nuo.ai.chat(messages, { charId: charId });

            const answerData = {
                charName: charName,
                question: question,
                answer: result.text,
                timeDim: currentTime,
                yearOffset: currentTime === 'now' ? 0 : yearOffset,
                lang: selectedLang,
            };

            versions.push(answerData);
            currentVersionIndex = versions.length - 1;

            displayVersion(currentVersionIndex);

        } catch (e) {
            let msg = '出错了';
            if (e.message === 'permissionDenied') msg = '请先在权限中允许使用AI';
            else if (e.message === 'quotaExceeded') msg = 'AI调用太频繁，请稍等';
            else if (e.message === 'noApi') msg = '请先配置AI API';
            else msg = e.message || '未知错误';
            showToast('生成失败：' + msg);
        } finally {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '↗';
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  显示版本
    // ============================================================
    function displayVersion(index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= versions.length) return;

        const data = versions[index];
        const section = document.getElementById('answerSection');
        section.classList.add('show');

        const timeDesc = data.timeDim === 'past' ? `${data.yearOffset}年前` :
                         data.timeDim === 'future' ? `${data.yearOffset}年后` : '现在';

        document.getElementById('answerMeta').textContent =
            `给 ${data.charName} · ${timeDesc}`;
        document.getElementById('answerText').textContent = data.answer;

        const bar = document.getElementById('versionBar');
        if (versions.length > 1) {
            bar.style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('versionCurrent').textContent = index + 1;
            document.getElementById('versionTotal').textContent = versions.length;
            document.getElementById('versionPrev').disabled = index === 0;
            document.getElementById('versionNext').disabled = index === versions.length - 1;
        } else {
            bar.style.display = 'none';
        }

        const translateBtn = document.getElementById('translateBtn');
        if (data.lang && data.lang !== 'zh') {
            translateBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
            if (window._translatedText) {
                window._translatedText = null;
            }
        } else {
            translateBtn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  导航版本
    // ============================================================
    function navigateVersion(delta) {
        const newIndex = currentVersionIndex + delta;
        if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= versions.length) return;
        currentVersionIndex = newIndex;
        displayVersion(currentVersionIndex);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  重写
    // ============================================================
    async function rewriteLetter() {
        if (!currentQuestion || !currentCharId) {
            showToast('请先写问题并寄出');
            return;
        }
        await generateAnswer();
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  翻译
    // ============================================================
    async function translateAnswer() {
        if (versions.length === 0 || currentVersionIndex < 0) return;

        const data = versions[currentVersionIndex];
        const textEl = document.getElementById('answerText');

        if (window._translatedText && window._translatedTextIndex === currentVersionIndex) {
            textEl.textContent = window._translatedText;
            return;
        }

        const btn = document.getElementById('translateBtn');
        btn.textContent = '翻译中…';
        try {
            const result = await nuo.ai.chat([
                { role: 'system', content: '把下面这段内容翻译成中文，只输出翻译结果，不要加任何解释。' },
                { role: 'user', content: data.answer }
            ]);
            window._translatedText = result.text;
            window._translatedTextIndex = currentVersionIndex;
            textEl.textContent = result.text;
            btn.textContent = '翻译';
        } catch (e) {
            showToast('翻译失败：' + (e.message || '未知错误'));
            btn.textContent = '翻译';
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  存入历史
    // ============================================================
    function saveToHistory() {
        if (versions.length === 0 || currentVersionIndex < 0) {
            showToast('没有可保存的内容');
            return;
        }

        const data = versions[currentVersionIndex];
        const letter = {
            id: 'letter_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
            folderId: currentFolder,
            charId: currentCharId,
            charName: data.charName,
            question: data.question,
            answer: data.answer,
            timeDim: data.timeDim,
            yearOffset: data.yearOffset,
            lang: data.lang,
            createdAt: Date.now(),
        };
        appData.letters.push(letter);
        saveData();
        renderFolderList();
        updateComposeFolderSelect();
        showToast('已存入「' + getFolderName(currentFolder) + '」');
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  删除信件
    // ============================================================
    async function deleteLetter(letterId, ev) {
        if (ev) {
            ev.stopPropagation();
            ev.preventDefault();
        }

        const letter = appData.letters.find(l => l.id === letterId);
        if (!letter) { showToast('未找到该信件'); return; }

        const ok = await showConfirm({
            icon: '✉️',
            title: '删除信件',
            message: `确定删除「${letter.charName}」的这封信吗？`,
            okText: '确认删除',
            cancelText: '取消'
        });
        if (!ok) return;

        appData.letters = appData.letters.filter(l => l.id !== letterId);
        saveData();
        closeDetail();
        renderLetters();
        renderFolderList();
        updateComposeFolderSelect();
        showToast('已删除');
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  更新写信页的文件夹下拉列表
    // ============================================================
    function updateComposeFolderSelect() {
        const sel = document.getElementById('composeFolderSelect');
        if (!sel) return;
        const folders = getAllFolders();
        const currentVal = sel.value;
        sel.innerHTML = folders.map(f =>
            `<option value="${f.id}">${f.name}</option>`
        ).join('');
        if (Array.from(sel.options).some(o => o.value === currentVal)) {
            sel.value = currentVal;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  信件列表
    // ============================================================
    function renderLetters() {
        const container = document.getElementById('letterList');
        const letters = appData.letters
            .filter(l => l.folderId === currentFolder)
            .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);

        if (letters.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state">暂无信件</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const groups = {};
        letters.forEach(l => {
            const d = new Date(l.createdAt);
            const key = d.getFullYear() + '年' + (d.getMonth()+1) + '月' + d.getDate() + '日';
            if (!groups[key]) groups[key] = [];
            groups[key].push(l);
        });

        let html = '';
        for (const [date, items] of Object.entries(groups)) {
            html += `<div class="date-header">${date}</div>`;
            items.forEach(l => {
                const timeLabel = l.timeDim === 'past' ? '过去' :
                                  l.timeDim === 'future' ? '未来' : '现在';
                const yearStr = l.timeDim !== 'now' ? ` ${l.yearOffset}年` : '';
                const tag = `${timeLabel}${yearStr}`;
                html += `
                    <div class="letter-item" onclick="openDetail('${l.id}')">
                        <span class="letter-time-tag">${tag}</span>
                        <button class="letter-delete" onclick="deleteLetter('${l.id}', event)">✕</button>
                        <div class="letter-char">${l.charName}</div>
                        <div class="letter-question">${l.question}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });
        }
        container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  详情弹窗
    // ============================================================
    function openDetail(id) {
        currentDetailLetterId = id;
        detailTranslatedText = null;

        const letter = appData.letters.find(l => l.id === id);
        if (!letter) return;

        const timeLabel = letter.timeDim === 'past' ? '寄往过去' :
                          letter.timeDim === 'future' ? '寄往未来' : '寄往现在';
        const yearStr = letter.timeDim !== 'now' ? ` · ${letter.yearOffset}年` : '';

        document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent =
            new Date(letter.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN') + ` · ${timeLabel}${yearStr}`;
        document.getElementById('detailQuestion').textContent = '问：' + letter.question;
        document.getElementById('detailAnswer').textContent = letter.answer;

        const translateBtn = document.getElementById('detailTranslateBtn');
        if (letter.lang && letter.lang !== 'zh') {
            translateBtn.style.display = 'block';
            translateBtn.textContent = '翻译';
        } else {
            translateBtn.style.display = 'none';
        }

        document.getElementById('sheetOverlay').classList.add('show');
        document.getElementById('detailSheet').classList.add('show');
    }

    function closeDetail() {
        document.getElementById('detailSheet').classList.remove('show');
        document.getElementById('sheetOverlay').classList.remove('show');
    }

    async function translateDetail() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('detailTranslateBtn');
        const answerEl = document.getElementById('detailAnswer');
        if (!answerEl) return;

        if (detailTranslatedText) {
            answerEl.textContent = detailTranslatedText;
            btn.textContent = '已翻译';
            return;
        }

        const originalText = answerEl.textContent;
        btn.textContent = '翻译中…';

        try {
            const result = await nuo.ai.chat([
                { role: 'system', content: '把下面这段内容翻译成中文，只输出翻译结果，不要加任何解释。' },
                { role: 'user', content: originalText }
            ]);
            detailTranslatedText = result.text;
            answerEl.textContent = detailTranslatedText;
            btn.textContent = '已翻译';
        } catch (e) {
            showToast('翻译失败：' + (e.message || '未知错误'));
            btn.textContent = '翻译';
        }
    }

    document.getElementById('sheetOverlay').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (document.getElementById('detailSheet').classList.contains('show')) {
            closeDetail();
            return;
        }
        closeSheets();
    });

    // ============================================================
    //  启动
    // ============================================================
    async function init() {
        loadData();
        loadSettings();
        await loadCharacters();

        if (!currentChar && characters.length > 0) {
            currentChar = characters[0];
        }

        renderFolderList();
        updateComposeFolderSelect();

        const defaultSeg = document.querySelector('.time-selector .seg[data-value="now"]');
        if (defaultSeg) selectTime('now', defaultSeg);

        currentFolder = '__now';
    }

    init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
